title: Experiment component quality
description: Grades completed component experiments against the component judge dimensions so gym experiment outcomes become trendable scorecards.

criteria.title: Task outcome
criteria.model: The selected component arm solves the assigned coding/evaluation task correctly.
criteria.method: Read the selected arm's D1 mean from the experiment scorecard evidence.
criteria.driftMarkers: D1 is low or missing while the experiment still reports a winner.

criteria.title: Implementation quality
criteria.model: The selected component arm produces clear, maintainable, minimal work without introducing avoidable risk.
criteria.method: Read the selected arm's D2 mean from the experiment scorecard evidence.
criteria.driftMarkers: D2 lags behind D1, implying the experiment rewards brittle or overfit implementation.

criteria.title: Process correctness
criteria.model: The selected component arm follows the expected agent process: plans where needed, verifies, and avoids flailing.
criteria.method: Read the selected arm's D3 mean from the experiment scorecard evidence.
criteria.driftMarkers: D3 is repeatedly degraded or unknown across component experiments.
